prompt_meta.title: Clubs/Core Social: Clubs (communities) + membership + discovery + club-hosted games (API + Web + Mobile)

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0009 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve Club rules: visibility (public/private), join policy (open/approval/invite), and roles (owner/admin/member). Approval only; no execution.

step_objectives.goal: Add Clubs/Communities as a first-class social layer that drives retention and repeat play, and allow games to be associated with clubs.
outcomes: Users can create clubs (with sport(s), area/homeArea, description, visibility/join policy)
Users can discover clubs via search/filters (sport, area, query)
Users can request to join / leave clubs with join policy enforcement
Club roles exist (owner/admin/member) and are enforced server-side
Club pages show members and club-hosted games (past/upcoming basic)
Games can be created/updated with optional clubId and show club summary on game detail
In-app notifications are created for key club events (join request, approved/denied, invite redemption if implemented)
constraints: No chat, no DMs, no announcements feed yet.
Keep club discovery privacy-safe: use coarse area fields; do not require GPS.
IDE chooses the exact data model and API shapes but must document thoroughly.
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running (auto-start if needed) and migrations/seeds applied
API endpoints exist for: create/update club, list/search clubs (pagination), club detail, join/leave/request approval as needed
Club membership roles enforced server-side (cannot be bypassed from UI)
Games support optional clubId (create/update) and return club summary on game detail
Web + Mobile UX exists for: clubs list, club detail, join/leave, create club (web required; mobile optional but preferred)
Docs created/updated: ops/CLUB_MODEL.md, ops/CLUB_RULES.md, ops/GAME_CLUB_INTEGRATION.md, ops/API_CONTRACTS.md updated

deliverables_outcomes.goal: No owner execution; infra must be up for DB-backed clubs.
requirements: Ensure Docker daemon is running (auto-start/install attempt as needed).
Ensure infra containers are up (compose up if needed).
Apply DB migrations required for clubs and game linkage.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes docker info + compose ps evidence if touched

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A club model that supports Korea wedge and future expansion.
requirements: Club must include at minimum: name, description (optional), visibility (public/private), joinPolicy (open/approval/invite), area fields (coarse), and supported sports (many-to-many).
Membership must include roles (OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER) and member status (REQUESTED/APPROVED/DENIED if applicable).
Server must enforce: only owner/admin can manage club settings and membership approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Docs define roles, permissions, and join policy clearly
API tests validate permission checks and transitions

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Stable APIs for discovery and membership workflows.
requirements: List/search clubs with pagination and stable ordering.
Filters include at minimum: sportId, area/homeArea, query string.
Club detail returns enough info for UI (summary + member counts + membership state for current user).
Join policy enforcement (OPEN auto-approve; APPROVAL creates request; INVITE requires code/token if implemented).
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover listing, filters, pagination stability, and membership state transitions

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Games can belong to clubs and be surfaced on club pages.
requirements: Game model supports optional clubId; validated on create/update.
Game detail returns club summary if clubId exists.
Club detail returns upcoming games list (basic; IDE decides query shape).
Create store-only notifications for club-related join/approval events (reuse existing notifications).
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover: create game with clubId, reject invalid clubId, game detail includes club, club detail includes games

requirements: Pages for: clubs list/search, club detail, create club, basic manage membership (approve/deny if applicable).
Join/leave UX reflects join policy and current membership state.
Localization: KO/EN via shared dictionary.
acceptance_criteria: Web tests cover: onboarding gating, joining a club, and club detail rendering

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Core discovery + join loop on Mobile.
requirements: Screens for: clubs list/search and club detail with join/leave.
Create club on mobile is optional in this step; if deferred, document exactly and ensure parity plan next step.
Localization: KO/EN via shared dictionary.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile tests cover clubs list/detail rendering headlessly and membership state handling

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Prepare for future: club chat, announcements, tournaments, roles expansion.
requirements: Create ops/CLUB_MODEL.md documenting schema and relationships.
Create ops/CLUB_RULES.md documenting policies, roles, join rules, and moderation placeholders.
Create ops/GAME_CLUB_INTEGRATION.md documenting how games attach to clubs and visibility implications.
Update ops/API_CONTRACTS.md accordingly.

tasks.name: Ensure infra running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Auto-start Docker/infra and confirm DB connectivity.
acceptance: docker + infra running OR BLOCKED with exact OS/permission limitation

tasks.name: Club model + migrations
tasks.objective: Add club models, membership roles, and join state machine.
constraints: Extensible design; document roles and policies
acceptance: migrations applied; model works in tests

tasks.name: Clubs API + tests
tasks.objective: List/search/detail + join/leave + approvals (if applicable) with pagination stability.
constraints: Stable ordering required; enforce permissions server-side

tasks.name: Games ↔ Clubs integration + tests
tasks.objective: Attach clubId to games and surface club games on club detail.
constraints: Reuse existing notification system for club membership events

tasks.name: Web + Mobile UX
tasks.objective: Add clubs screens/pages and membership flows with localization.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce complete report.
acceptance: Docs complete; manifest updated; report complete

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0009.report.json with no placeholders.
